    """Return (min_area, k smallest (area, i, j, k) tuples) over all C(13,3) triangles."""
    n = len(points)
    i, j = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    k = np.arange(n)
    # Build all triangles: for each triple (a,b,c) with a<b, c> b... use combinatorial indexing
    from itertools import combinations
    idx = np.array(list(combinations(range(n), 3)))
    a = points[idx[:, 0]]
    b = points[idx[:, 1]]
    c = points[idx[:, 2]]
    areas = 0.5 * np.abs(
        (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) * (c[:, 1] - a[:, 1])
        - (b[:, 1] - a[:, 1]) * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
    )
    order = np.argsort(areas)
    return areas, idx, order

    """True minimum triangle area over all C(13,3) triangles."""

import numpy as np


def _min_triangle_info(points):
    """Return (min_area, k smallest (area, i, j, k) tuples) over all C(13,3) triangles."""
    n = len(points)
    i, j = np.triu_indices(n, k=1)
    k = np.arange(n)
    # Build all triangles: for each triple (a,b,c) with a<b, c> b... use combinatorial indexing
    from itertools import combinations
    idx = np.array(list(combinations(range(n), 3)))
    a = points[idx[:, 0]]
    b = points[idx[:, 1]]
    c = points[idx[:, 2]]
    areas = 0.5 * np.abs(
        (b[:, 0] - a[:, 0]) * (c[:, 1] - a[:, 1])
        - (b[:, 1] - a[:, 1]) * (c[:, 0] - a[:, 0])
    )
    order = np.argsort(areas)
    return areas, idx, order
